nvitk.io.writers.pil
====================

.. py:module:: nvitk.io.writers.pil

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Save 2D or ``YXC`` arrays with Pillow (format from file extension).



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.io.writers.pil._to_uint8
   nvitk.io.writers.pil.write_pil


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: _to_uint8(arr: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

   Coerce an array to uint8 for image writers: floats are treated as ``[0, 1]``, ints are clipped to ``[0, 255]``.


.. py:function:: write_pil(path: str, data: Any, *, axes: str | None = None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> None

   Write raster image; floats are scaled to uint8 when needed.
